questions.text: Does the document explicitly call for rapid and urgent action on climate change?
questions.answer: The document does explicitly call for rapid and urgent action on climate change. It refers to three primary international drivers for urgent action on climate change: the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the Paris Agreement, and the Special IPCC report on 1.5°C warming. The SDGs, adopted in 2015, call for action from all countries to end poverty and promote prosperity while protecting the planet. The Paris Agreement, adopted the same year, calls for signatory countries to work to limit global temperature rise to well below 2°C Celsius, and strive for 1.5°C Celsius. The Special IPCC report on 1.5°C warming, approved in 2018, indicates that achieving this would require rapid, far-reaching and unprecedented changes in all aspects of society. These references clearly indicate a call for rapid and urgent action on climate change.
